# ComfyUI workflow templates

The Studio preset preview images in `src/assets/studio-presets/` are the first
frames of the thumbnails (`templates/<name>-1.webp`) of ComfyUI workflow
templates from <https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates>, resized to
480 px WebP. MIT License, Copyright (c) 2023-present Comfy Org; the full text
is in [LICENSE](LICENSE).
